findings.problem: Same concept as "copy" is rendered "câu chữ" at the head of the same string and "chữ" here; "chữ sản phẩm" is an awkward compound to parse at a glance on a 256 px card line.
findings.suggestion: "câu chữ sản phẩm mà người dùng thấy" (or "câu chữ trong sản phẩm người dùng thấy").

findings.problem: "dàn thử" for "rig" is an unreviewed coinage with no occurrence in the vi catalogue and is not the conventional engineering term; the translator itself flagged this row as the one open glossary question.
findings.suggestion: "giàn thử" (conventional test-rig form) or "môi trường thử"; record whichever is chosen in i18n/glossary.md or the vi guide.

findings.current: "Đi trọn luồng thật của thay đổi từ đầu đến cuối"
findings.problem: Pleonasm: "trọn" and "từ đầu đến cuối" both carry "the whole"; doubled in a card blurb it reads clumsy.
findings.suggestion: "Đi hết luồng thật của thay đổi: …" or "Đi luồng thật của thay đổi từ đầu đến cuối: …".

findings.problem: Collocation for "claim support"; "cơ sở cho" + bare noun reads thin in a criteria list.
findings.suggestion: "căn cứ cho các khẳng định" or "tính có căn cứ của khẳng định".

findings.problem: "AI-isms" names a defect class (AI-flavoured tics); the Vietnamese is neutral description ("the writing style characteristic of AI") and loses the critical edge.
findings.suggestion: "lối viết rập khuôn kiểu AI" (keeps AI as Latin).

findings.problem: "negative cases" is deliberately invalid/adversarial input, not merely error cases; the shorthand narrows the claim.
findings.suggestion: "trường hợp không hợp lệ" or "ca kiểm thử âm".

findings.problem: Reads "measurable geometry"; the English asserts geometry that is measured (numbers, not impressions).

findings.current: "Rà soát mã độc lập cho diff, MR hoặc PR"
findings.problem: "mã độc lập" is momentarily available as a noun phrase ("independent code") before the following clause disambiguates; the sibling qa_tester card puts the adverb first ("Bằng chứng thực thi độc lập").
findings.suggestion: "Rà soát độc lập mã cho diff, MR hoặc PR" (or "Rà soát mã một cách độc lập cho …").

method.pass_1: Mechanical (key parity, JSON, NFC, placeholders, ellipsis, whitespace, ratio) then per-value semantic comparison against the English source and its context sidecar.
method.pass_2: Values re-read in isolation and paraphrased back to English before comparison; then checked against the core glossary and the vi style guide. Second pass withdrew one finding from pass 1 (a register objection to "Chánh văn phòng": the vi guide records chief of staff -> chánh văn phòng as a binding wave-2 decision) and confirmed the rest.
method.tools: python (json/unicodedata/hashlib) locally; node scripts/i18n/generate.mjs --check; no translation or MT service used

notes: No BLOCKER and no MAJOR: every value carries the English claim, nothing dropped or added, and the register is consistent with the shipped vi catalogue. Findings are polish (3 MINOR, 5 NIT), all in ui.agents.descriptions; the install labels have none. Delivered .en.json snapshots differ from the catalogue English only in whitespace (verified by parsed-content equality), so the namespace sha256 values name the catalogue bytes the ledger will re-derive.
